correctness.rationale: Partial-fraction Fourier transform of g gives, up to nonzero scale, h_lambda(t)=exp(-lambda|t|)(1-exp(-lambda|t|))^2; alternating p-periodization sums to rational R_u(L). Evenness/antiperiodicity pair compatible columns and rows of the cited fiber, reducing a singular even block to the specified 100x100 C(u). Independently implemented fixed 192-bit outward integer intervals and full Gaussian elimination on both exact rational u values: sign(det C(969/1000))=-1 with 99 negative pivots, sign(det C(31/32))=+1 with 100 negative pivots; no interval pivot met zero, worst certified width ~2.14e-50. Continuous rational matrix entries imply a real root between u=31/32 and 969/1000. Both map to beta>1 by the rational -log(1-t)>t+t^2/2 and pi<22/7. General Zibulski–Zeevi fiber singularity => non-frame is relied upon from the cited Ghosh work and not independently reproved in full; its full source remained inaccessible.
residual_risks: The full Ghosh 2026 paper and earlier symmetric-pole preprint were not available to inspect in full; the matrix-to-fiber equivalence rests on the cited theorem and audited symmetry algebra. OAuth/VPN prevented the authorized retrieval; no bypass attempted.
